description: This file contains unit tests for the KafkaValidator class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.kafka package. Its tests focus on validation logic for Kafka connection configurations, including address formats, bootstrap servers, and immutability checks.

classes.name: KafkaValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the behavior of KafkaValidator, including immutability, address validation, bootstrap server validation, and handling of invalid configurations.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, including setting up default configuration and creating an ActorSystem.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares a new instance of KafkaValidator before each test.

methods.name: testSourcesAreInvalid
methods.description: Verifies that invalid sources throw ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: testValidTargetAddress
methods.description: Validates various correct Kafka target address formats.

methods.name: testInvalidTargetAddress
methods.description: Ensures invalid target address formats throw the expected exception.

methods.name: testValidBootstrapServers
methods.description: Validates various correct bootstrap server configurations.

methods.name: testInvalidBootstrapServers
methods.description: Checks that invalid bootstrap server configurations throw ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: getConnectionWithTarget
methods.description: Creates a Connection object with a specified target address for testing.

methods.name: getConnectionWithBootstrapServers
methods.description: Creates a Connection object with specified bootstrap servers for testing.

methods.name: verifyConnectionConfigurationInvalidExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Helper method to assert that a given connection validation throws ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.
